title: AnomalyCLIP: Object-agnostic Prompt Learning for Zero-shot Anomaly Detection
mechanism: Object-agnostic normal / abnormal text prompts learned on auxiliary data give zero-shot anomaly maps for unseen objects.
adaptation: Zero-shot benchmark row only: run on EL with no EL training, report gap to supervised and to AA-CLIP trained on E-SCDD (pixel AP 0.55, D07).
evidence: R: zero-shot on many industrial and medical datasets (257 citations).
min_experiment: Benchmark row, inference only; no kill line.
